description: Box-score-level summary of MLB game(s) played by one team on one date, from Retrosheet game logs (1871-2025): final score, game length, day/night, park, attendance, winning/losing/saving pitcher, managers, and each side's at-bats/hits/doubles/triples/homers/RBI/walks/strikeouts/errors. Covers regular season plus All-Star, Division Series, League Championship Series, Wild Card and World Series games (see game_type in the response: R/A/D/L/C/W). Pass date as "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYYMMDD" and team as a code ("NYA") or common name ("Yankees"). Returns an array because doubleheaders are two games on one date. This is a per-game SUMMARY, not a play-by-play log -- no pitch or at-bat level detail is stored. No games found for a valid date/team combination is reported as found:false with the reason, never an empty array treated as success.

team.description: Team code ("BOS") or common name ("Red Sox").
